parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - Leave Request Processor
Employee submits via form.
GPT-4o checks balance + rules and decides: auto-approve, needs review, or flag.
Sick leave <3 days and emergency = instant approval.
All others go to Slack for manager review.
Logs everything to Airtable.
